assumptions: Receivables not yet due: 97% collected in their due week.
Receivables 1-60 days overdue: 80% collected within 2 weeks.
Receivables more than 60 days overdue: 40% collected in week 4, rest excluded.
Supplier invoices paid in their due week; overdue ones in week 1.
Fixed costs 3773.88/month spread evenly per week.

finding.comment: Income statement accounts have an opening balance

remediations.explanation: Profit-and-loss accounts (3000-8999) carry an opening balance of −8 813 187,54 kr. P&L accounts must start each year at zero; last year's result should have been transferred to equity at year end.
likelyCauses: Year-end closing (årsavslutning / disponering) was not performed for the previous year.
Opening balance import placed the previous result on a result account instead of equity.
The system shows the pseudo-account '0 - Udisponert resultat', meaning the result is not yet allocated.
diagnostics: List P&L accounts with non-zero IB in 2026.
Check whether a year-end allocation entry exists dated 2025-12-31.

proposedEntries.title: Transfer 2025 result to equity (disponering)
proposedEntries.caution: Standard year-end allocation. If dividends or tax were decided, split the counter-post accordingly (2800 utbytte, 2500 betalbar skatt).

finding.comment: The opening balance has a difference

remediations.explanation: The opening balance (IB) for 2026 does not sum to zero: debits and credits differ by 8 813 187,54 kr. A balance sheet must balance, so the IB was imported or posted incompletely. The difference equals the opening balance sitting on P&L accounts, so it disappears once last year's result is transferred to equity (see the 'Income statement opening balance' remediation).
likelyCauses: Previous year's result never closed to equity (year-end allocation not run), so the balance-sheet side lacks its equity counter-post.
diagnostics: Trial balance for 2026 period 1 with opening balances: which accounts carry IB?
Journal entries dated 2026-01-01 or earlier with 'IB' or 'Inngående balanse' in the description.
Compare closing balance 2025 period 12 with IB 2026 per account.

finding.comment: Liability account has a positive balance

remediations.explanation: Account 2710 (Inngående merverdiavgift, høy sats) holds input VAT of 2 156 851,69 kr that has never been settled. Input VAT is a receivable from the state until the VAT return (mva-melding) is run, which nets the 2700-series accounts against 2740 Oppgjørskonto merverdiavgift.
likelyCauses: VAT returns have not been run or booked for the periods (common in demo companies).
VAT settlement entries were posted to the wrong account.
diagnostics: Statistics: sum of JournalEntryLine.Amount on 2710 per VAT period for 2026.
Check VatReport status per bi-monthly term for 2026.

proposedEntries.title: Run the VAT return for each open term instead of posting manually
proposedEntries.caution: Do not post manually: create and approve the mva-melding for each term in the system; it books 2700/2710 against 2740 automatically and files to Skatteetaten.

remediations.explanation: 5 274 740,00 kr of customer payments and credit notes sit on the receivables ledger without being matched to an invoice (payments not matched to invoices). Open invoices therefore look 5 274 740,00 kr too high, reminders may go to customers who have already paid, and the aging report overstates what is overdue.
likelyCauses: Bank payments imported and posted to the customer but never matched (KID missing or amount differs).
Credit notes issued without being applied to the original invoice.
Payments registered manually on the customer instead of on the invoice.
diagnostics: Sales → Kunder → customer → Åpne poster: lines with a negative rest amount are the unmatched payments.
Regnskap → Åpne poster: use 'Match' to pair payments with invoices, oldest first.

proposedEntries.title: Match payments to invoices (no journal entry needed)
proposedEntries.caution: Matching changes no balances, only which invoices count as paid. Do it before sending any reminders.

remediations.explanation: Output VAT 4 743 350,00 kr is booked on the 2700-series accounts but no VAT return exists for 2026. Until the VAT return (mva-melding) is created and approved for each two-month term, the VAT accounts are never settled against 2740 and the liability to Skatteetaten is not visible.
likelyCauses: VAT returns were never produced in this company (typical for demo or freshly migrated companies).
Terms were produced but not approved/booked.
diagnostics: Regnskap → Mva-melding: list of terms and their status for the year.
Balance on 2740 Oppgjørskonto merverdiavgift should move at each term.

proposedEntries.title: Create and approve the VAT return for each open term
proposedEntries.caution: Never post VAT settlement manually; the mva-melding function books 2700/2710 against 2740 and files to Altinn.

revision.note: Use book_correcting_entry to book a proposed entry after an accountant has approved it.

drafts.rationale: Oldest invoice 1112 days overdue and past the inkassovarsel window; hand over to collection.
drafts.text:
Jeg anbefaler at kravet mot Lofoten Anlegg ASA overføres til inkassobyrå. Kunden har flere svært gamle forfalte fakturaer, hvor eldste restanse er over tre år. Totalt utestående etter hensyntatt ikke-matchede innbetalinger er 65 705,00 kroner. Vi har allerede sendt purringer uten å oppnå full betaling, og betalingsviljen fremstår som lav. For å sikre videre inndrivelse og ivareta våre interesser bør saken nå håndteres av profesjonell inkassoaktør.

Med vennlig hilsen DEMO JN AS

drafts.rationale: Oldest invoice 837 days overdue and past the inkassovarsel window; hand over to collection.
drafts.text:
Jeg anbefaler at kundefordringen mot Roar Brekke overføres til inkassobyrå. Kunden har flere sterkt forfalte fakturaer, hvor de eldste er over to år gamle. Totalt reelt forfalt beløp, etter fratrekk av ikke-allokerte innbetalinger på 14 162,50 kroner, utgjør 64 375,00 kroner. 

Til tross for purringer og lang kredittid har kunden ikke gjort opp sitt mellomværende i henhold til avtale. Videre intern oppfølging vurderes som lite hensiktsmessig, og risikoen for ytterligere tap øker ved ytterligere utsettelse.

Med vennlig hilsen DEMO JN AS
